epic.name: Task board, task detail, and settings
unverifiedAssumptions: The 'active' column given the blue heading is In progress (To do stays neutral, Done is green). The design only colours Done; the requirement says the active column header uses primary blue without naming which — confirm In progress is intended.

Until Settings ships, the header shows the signed-in person's name from the fixed seeded team (by email); renaming yourself won't update the header until Settings adds the saved-name store (resolved by Story 3).
